subject.title: feat: add disableBoundaryAwareCache compat option for prefix-matching prompt cache providers

question: Should DeepSeek prefix-cache suffix relocation become a supported public `compat.disableBoundaryAwareCache` setting, or remain an internal provider-specific behavior without new configuration surface?
rationale: Both shapes can address the regression, but the repository's high bar for new config and provider-default contracts requires explicit maintainer intent; code review cannot choose that durable product boundary alone.

options.title: Keep provider-internal
options.body: Retain the DeepSeek-specific suffix relocation and focused coverage without adding a new public compatibility key.

options.title: Approve public compat key
options.body: Accept the setting as a documented model-config contract for DeepSeek and future providers with separately proven prefix-cache behavior.

options.title: Wait for live metrics
options.body: Defer the permanent API choice until provider-reported multi-turn cache-hit output proves the request-shape improvement.

recommendation.title: Keep provider-internal
recommendation.body: Retain the DeepSeek-specific suffix relocation and focused coverage without adding a new public compatibility key.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main ownership of the central conversion path and explicit PR engagement make `steipete` the strongest available decision owner.
